summary.oneLiner: Integrated power solutions provider specialising in diesel generator sets (Cummins OEM) and medium-speed large generators (Hyundai), with a wind-power IPP business.
summary.business: Powerica manufactures and supplies DG sets (7.5-3,750 kVA) powered by Cummins engines as a long-standing Cummins OEM, and medium-speed large generators (3,000-10,000 kVA) in collaboration with Hyundai, plus allied products (EMI shelters, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA panels). Since 2008 it also operates a Wind Power Business as an independent power producer (330.85 MW operational in Gujarat) and provides EPC and O&M services for balance-of-plant. Generator Set Business is ~80-86% of revenue.

currentContext.business: Powerica manufactures and supplies DG sets (7.5-3,750 kVA) powered by Cummins engines as a long-standing Cummins OEM, and medium-speed large generators (3,000-10,000 kVA) in collaboration with Hyundai, plus allied products (EMI shelters, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA panels). Since 2008 it also operates a Wind Power Business as an independent power producer (330.85 MW operational in Gujarat) and provides EPC and O&M services for balance-of-plant. Generator Set Business is ~80-86% of revenue.

Generator Set Business: DG sets powered by Cummins engines (7.5-3,750 kVA)
MSLG sets with Hyundai (3,000-10,000 kVA / 3-10 MW)
Allied: EMI shelters/containers, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA control panels & switchboards
Wind Power Business: IPP wind power projects (330.85 MW operational)

currentContext.expansion: Constructing Orchid Phase II (52.70 MW, SECI Wind Tranche-XVII, tariff Rs 3.81/kWh, SCOD March 1, 2027) to take IPP portfolio to 383.55 MW; pipeline of Project Alpha (50 MW), Project Beta (100 MW wind + 30 MW solar), Project Gama (100 MW) in Gujarat (won GUVNL Phase X bids at Rs 3.44 and Rs 3.43/kWh). Executing MSLG orders: 63 MW for NPCIL and 10 MW EDG for an Australian fertiliser plant.

one-line thesis: First call post-IPO: a debt-free (post-IPO ₹525cr repaid), cash-rich, integrated power-solutions player riding data-center high-HP genset demand and a fast-growing high-margin wind IPP/EPC book, with CPCB4+ retrofit (Platino) as embedded optionality — near-term (Q1FY27) demand soft on geopolitics.
financial scorecard:
| Metric | Q4 FY26 | FY26 | YoY | One-offs / notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue from ops | ₹801 cr | ₹3,012 cr | +10.9% Q4 / +13.5% FY (crossed ₹3,000cr first time) | — |
| EBITDA / margin | ₹86 cr / 10.8% | ₹386 cr / 12.8% | — | Q3/Q4 margins subdued vs Q1/Q2 (geopolitics) |
| PAT / margin | ₹45 cr / 5.6% | ₹277 cr / 9.2% | — | FY PAT lifted by ₹51cr deferred-tax credit (regime change) |
| Wind segment rev | — | ₹512 cr (16.9% of rev) | +28.6% | EBITDA margin 31.3%; IPP 40% / EPC+O&M 60% |
| Platino (associate) | ₹22 cr sales / ₹5.8 cr PBT (Q4) | — | — | Start-up; FY26 spent on marketing infra |
| Cash incl. investments | — | ~₹450 cr (as of 26-May) | — | Debt of ₹525cr repaid in Q1FY27 |

Segment mix FY26: Genset 83% of rev (DG-Cummins ~66%, MSLG ~5%, +balance); Allied 12.5%; Wind 16.9%. Genset EBITDA margin 9.1%; wind 31.3%. HSP (high-horsepower) >50% of value.
guidance (next quarter / fy27):
- **Q1FY27 explicitly flagged soft** — geopolitical tension/energy prices/supply chain weigh on near-term demand; mgmt calls it "transient."
- FY27 group target: **double-digit topline growth**; DG organic **11–12%** (vs industry ~10.5%), MSLG milestone-lumpy on top.
- Wind: higher generation/margin in **H1 (Q1–Q2)** vs H2 (seasonal IPP PLF); new 50 MW revenue from FY27 (Q2 onward).
- Finance cost to drop sharply in Q1FY27 post debt repayment → PAT margin accretion. Higher depreciation expected as 50 MW (possibly +another 50 MW) capitalized.
order book & pipeline:
- **Data centers**: order book ~9 months to 1 year of work; inquiries "consistently ongoing," surge post-budget. DC = ~12% of Cummins (66%) business in FY26.
- **DG/HSP**: 6–7 month healthy order book; HSP >50% of value.
- **Wind EPC/BoP**: ~585 MW order pipeline being executed to Dec'27 — 175 MW Gujarat (Airpower, complete by Dec'26) + 410 MW Maharashtra (Torrent Power, Beed). ~₹1.6–1.7cr/MW → ~₹400cr/yr steady BoP business.
- **Wind IPP**: 330.85 MW operating; +52.7 MW under construction (→384 MW); +100 MW GUVNL bid won (Botad); +50 MW advanced planning. Khavda 2 GW RE JV with GE Vernova pending Gujarat land allotment.
- MSLG Australia project ~90–95% complete + ongoing O&M service order secured.
segment / subsidiary detail:
- **DG Sets (Cummins, since 1984)**: 7.5–3,750 kVA; ~66% of FY26 rev; 3 plants (Bangalore, Silvassa, Khopoli); in-house everything except engine & alternator.
- **MSLG (Hyundai, since 1996)**: 3,000–10,000 kVA; ~5% rev; project-driven, 12–48 month cycles — evaluate multi-quarter. No capex needed (service-led).
- **Allied (12.5%)**: EMI shelters, containers, defence apps, acoustic enclosures, Schneider Prisma panels.
- **Wind (16.9%, ₹512cr)**: IPP (25-yr PPAs with GUVNL/SECI, fixed tariff) + EPC + O&M for BoP. New machines PLF 36.5% vs old 23–24%; portfolio avg ~26%. IPP EBITDA 60–62% (new projects 87–88% yr-1, stabilize 82–83%).
- **Platino Automotive (associate)**: RECD retrofit device, ₹3L–₹30L/install, reduces DG emissions up to 92%, addresses 125 kVA+ and every pre-CPCB4 DG set in India.
growth verticals / optionality:
- Data-center high-HP gensets (entered 2021; hyperscaler + colo relationships) — core driver.
- Platino CPCB4+ retrofit — huge legacy DG addressable base, state-mandate-driven; expected to grow faster than DG (>10–12%).
- EV charging-station DG backup as stations move outside metros (next-year optionality).
- Rental fleet market picking up.
- Wind hybrid: wind-solar-BESS, RTC/FDRE power, C&I PPAs (data centers, cement, steel); 500 GW national RE target tailwind.
margins & cost dynamics:
- Wind structurally high-margin (31.3%, IPP 60%+); DG stable ~9.1%. Blended FY26 EBITDA 12.8%.
- Q3/Q4 margin dip attributed to Q4 geopolitical tension extending into Q1FY27 — mgmt frames as temporary.
- Finance cost set to fall materially post ₹525cr debt repayment, directly lifting PAT margin.
- Revenue mix to shift toward 75–80% genset / 20–25% wind, but EBITDA mix shifts more toward wind.
capex / expansion:
- FY26: 51.3 MW of wind capex executed.
- FY27: ~50 MW (possibly +another 50 MW) to be capitalized → higher depreciation. MSLG needs no capex.
- Khavda 2 GW RE JV (GE Vernova) gated on Gujarat land allotment — not yet acquired.
capital allocation:
- Post-IPO: repaid ₹525cr debt in Q1FY27; ~₹450cr cash+investments — now effectively net cash.
- Wind EPC done with low equity deployment (BoP for third parties). IPP portfolio to grow ~one project/yr over 4–5 yrs.
- No dividend/buyback mentioned (first call post-listing).
risks & watch-items:
- Q1FY27 demand softness (geopolitics, energy prices, supply chain) — verify recovery from Q2.
- Wind ROW (right-of-way) issues "not improving"; land/connectivity constraints; rising RE competition/supply-demand gap.
- Khavda 2 GW stalled on land allotment — execution-timeline risk.
- MSLG lumpiness can distort single-quarter reads.
- Tech disruption: fuel cells (e.g. Bloom Energy in US) as long-term DC backup substitute — mgmt downplays (genset = insurance; they're "part to market").
- Platino still sub-scale; revenue ramp depends on state enforcement of CPCB4+.
management quality / tone: Confident, candid, detail-rich for a debut call. Gave specific PLF/EBITDA splits, segment %s, and freely flagged Q1FY27 softness rather than glossing — credibility-positive. Framed itself as "power-solutions provider, not a DG manufacturer." Some answers evasive on DC % of customer capex (genuinely not knowable to them).
non-obvious takeaways:
- Wind IPP top-line ≈ bottom-line (very high margin) — small revenue %, outsized EBITDA contribution; the mix-shift story is more an EBITDA story than a revenue story.
- ₹51cr deferred-tax credit flatters FY26 PAT — normalize for true run-rate.
- DC is only ~12% of the 66% Cummins business (~8% of group) yet positioned as headline driver; manufacturing + realty remain the bigger volume base.
- "Part to market" framing: even fuel-cell/new-tech disruption routes through Powerica's installation/service moat.
- EPC BoP (~₹400cr/yr steady) is capital-light, asset-light revenue distinct from balance-sheet-heavy IPP.

**This quarter (Q4/FY26 — debut call):**
- First earnings call post-IPO; ₹525cr debt repaid (Q1FY27), ~₹450cr cash on hand.
- FY26 revenue ₹3,012cr (+13.5%, first time >₹3,000cr); EBITDA 12.8%; PAT ₹277cr (incl. ₹51cr deferred-tax credit).
- Wind +28.6% to ₹512cr at 31.3% EBITDA; DC ~12% of Cummins business; Platino Q4 ₹22cr sales / ₹5.8cr PBT.
- Q4 margins softened on geopolitics; Q1FY27 flagged soft.

**Next-quarter watch items:**
- Q1FY27 demand recovery vs flagged softness; verify Q2 inflection.
- Finance-cost drop flowing through to PAT margin (post debt repayment).
- New 50 MW wind capitalization → depreciation step-up & H1 generation margin.
- DC order-book conversion and contribution lift in FY27.
- Platino revenue acceleration as state CPCB4+ enforcement scales.
- Khavda 2 GW land allotment progress; wind ROW situation.

themes.title: Consumer durables, cooling & electricals
themes.need: Rising incomes, electrification and a record cooling season drive consumer-electricals and appliances - HAVELLS/VOLTAS/BLUESTARCO/SYMPHONY/ORIENTELEC on cooling & electricals; TTKPRESTIG/STOVEKRAFT/BAJAJELEC/EUREKAFORB on kitchen/home; CROMPTON-tier fans & pumps; premiumization + GST 2.0 + summer demand expand the organized share. Q1FY27's small-cap read: SONAMLTD grew revenue 75.6% YoY to INR 66.57cr on a cheap raw-material inventory position taken 6-7 months in advance while selling prices rose - management explicitly called the 75% print non-repeatable and guided FY27 to 25-30% with a Q2 floor of INR 40-50cr - and is pivoting from volume to INR 5,000-15,000 value clocks with capacity utilisation still only 60-70%.
themes.driver: Summer cooling demand; GST 2.0 price cuts; festive restocking; commodity-cost tailwind on margins; premiumization/ASP mix shift.

themes.title: Power generation & utilities - baseload + new capacity
themes.need: Record peak demand and a thermal+hydro+nuclear capacity-addition cycle underpin regulated and merchant generators plus their service chain. NTPC/JSWENERGY/TATAPOWER/TORNTPOWER/ADANIPOWER add thermal + RE; NHPC/SJVN/NLCINDIA on hydro/lignite; TRITURBINE/TDPOWERSYS/GVPIL on turbines/generators & aftermarket; POWERMECH on EPC + O&M.
themes.driver: Peak-demand/PLF strength; new-unit commissioning; FGD + thermal-aftermarket order conversion.

hero.oneLiner: Integrated power solutions provider specialising in diesel generator sets (Cummins OEM) and medium-speed large generators (Hyundai), with a wind-power IPP business.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Integrated power solutions provider specialising in diesel generator sets (Cummins OEM) and medium-speed large generators (Hyundai), with a wind-power IPP business.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Powerica manufactures and supplies DG sets (7.5-3,750 kVA) powered by Cummins engines as a long-standing Cummins OEM, and medium-speed large generators (3,000-10,000 kVA) in collaboration with Hyundai, plus allied products (EMI shelters, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA panels). Since 2008 it also operates a Wind Power Business as an independent power producer (330.85 MW operational in Gujarat) and provides EPC and O&M services for balance-of-plant. Generator Set Business is ~80-86% of revenue.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Cummins India Limited — Key supplier / OEM principal: Engine & alternator supply under General Supply Agreement dated June 11, 2025 (non-exclusive)
- HD Hyundai Heavy Industries — MSLG collaboration: Non-exclusive
- Powerica Renewable Infra Pvt Ltd / Vartaman Wind Energy / Windstride Power — Group/subsidiary entities: Wind power infra

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Generator Set Business:** DG sets powered by Cummins engines (7.5-3,750 kVA), MSLG sets with Hyundai (3,000-10,000 kVA / 3-10 MW), Allied: EMI shelters/containers, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA control panels & switchboards
- **Wind Power Business:** IPP wind power projects (330.85 MW operational), EPC for balance-of-plant, O&M services for balance-of-plant

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Commercial (hospitality, healthcare, BFSI, education, real estate)
- Infrastructure (retail, logistics, railways, metros)
- Manufacturing/process industries, dairy
- Agriculture (cold storage, aquaculture)
- IT/data centres
- Government and defence
- Rentals
- State/central distribution utilities (wind power)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: In-house manufacturing at three plants (Bengaluru, Silvassa, Khopoli) with direct control over process, cost and timelines; engines/alternators sourced from Cummins (top supplier 46.84% of total expenses in FY25); MSLG sets from Hyundai. Wind: in-house EPC-for-BoP and O&M capabilities. 43 authorised dealers (joint certification with Cummins), 19 sales offices.

customers.title: Oem (RHP)
customers.body:
- Cummins India Limited (engine/alternator supply; DG sets OEM)
- HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co., Limited (MSLG, non-exclusive)
- GE Vernova
- Vestas
- Schneider Electric (PRISMA panels)

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Generator Set Business (~80-86% of revenue) mix, with DG sets on Cummins engines the single largest line (56.77-71.04%)
- MSLG orders have long 2-3 year gestation; lumpy revenue recognition
- Wind Power revenue stable with fixed-tariff PPAs; receivable days 39-60 days
- Divested two Tamil Nadu IPP wind projects (26.4 MW) in FY24

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Grow MSLG business (Hyundai) including international orders (NPCIL 63 MW; Australia 10 MW EDG)
- Expand wind IPP portfolio (Orchid Phase II 52.70 MW + pipeline of 250 MW wind + 30 MW solar in Gujarat)
- Deepen EPC/O&M for balance-of-plant for own and third-party IPPs
- Leverage Cummins alliance for evolving emission/technology standards

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Constructing Orchid Phase II (52.70 MW, SECI Wind Tranche-XVII, tariff Rs 3.81/kWh, SCOD March 1, 2027) to take IPP portfolio to 383.55 MW; pipeline of Project Alpha (50 MW), Project Beta (100 MW wind + 30 MW solar), Project Gama (100 MW) in Gujarat (won GUVNL Phase X bids at Rs 3.44 and Rs 3.43/kWh). Executing MSLG orders: 63 MW for NPCIL and 10 MW EDG for an Australian fertiliser plant.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Four-decade Cummins OEM relationship; established position in DG-set market (LHP/MHP/HHP, 7.5-3,750 kVA)
- Collaborations with Cummins, Hyundai, GE Vernova, Vestas, Schneider Electric
- Integrated manufacturing (3 plants) with in-house design, installation and O&M
- 15+ years wind IPP track record; 330.85 MW operational on long-term fixed-tariff PPAs (GUVNL/SECI), weighted-avg remaining life 18 years
- Balanced portfolio across generator sets and renewable power

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Generator Set Business concentration — 80.50%/85.00%/86.30%/82.79% of revenue (H1FY26/FY25/FY24/FY23); DG sets on Cummins engines 56.77-71.04%
- Dependence on Cummins — Engines/alternators sourced from Cummins under a non-exclusive supply agreement; OEM relationship critical
- Dependence on Hyundai for MSLG — MSLG sets rely on a non-exclusive Hyundai association
- Wind geographic concentration (Gujarat) — All operational wind projects in Gujarat; PPAs with GUVNL/SECI
- Project construction / execution risk — Under-construction and pipeline wind projects face delay and cost-overrun risk
- Long MSLG gestation — MSLG orders take 2-3 years from inquiry to commissioning; lumpy execution (NPCIL 63 MW)

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Commission Orchid Phase II (52.70 MW) wind project by SCOD March 1, 2027.**
- **Develop pipeline of 250 MW wind + 30 MW solar in Gujarat (Projects Alpha/Beta/Gama).**
- **Execute 63 MW (10x6.3MW) MSLG project for NPCIL.**
- **Execute 10 MW EDG MSLG order for an Australian fertiliser plant (USD 10.23m).**
- **Use fresh-issue net proceeds (Rs 700 cr) to prepay/repay certain outstanding borrowings.**
